title: SGMC资本Mohit：印尼市场估值吸引，悲观中孕育机会
speaker: Mohit Mipuri

segments.en: November is now the next key date. Investors will still have to deal with the volatility that this tail risk brings.
segments.zh: 11月现在是下一个关键日期。投资者仍需应对尾部风险带来的波动。

segments.en: This is not January 2026 when markets were at all-time highs. We are now at levels that already reflect a lot of this risk.
segments.zh: 这不是2026年1月市场处于历史高位的时候。我们现在处于已经反映了很多风险的价位。

segments.en: JCI is down 32% in dollar terms as of yesterday, even after rebounding about 17% from the 8 June low.
segments.zh: 截至昨日，雅加达综合指数以美元计下跌32%，即使已从6月8日低点反弹约17%。

segments.en: The market is trading around nine times forward earnings, valuations are appealing, positioning is light, and expectations are low.
segments.zh: 市场交易在约9倍远期收益，估值吸引人，仓位轻，预期低。

segments.en: These are typically good ingredients for an investor to work with.
segments.zh: 这些通常是投资者可以利用的好因素。

segments.en: Our message is simple. Don't stay selective, but don't be paralyzed by the headlines.
segments.zh: 我们的信息很简单。保持选择性，但不要被头条新闻吓倒。
